# Stop That Shit attribution

Source repository: https://github.com/lennney/stop-that-shit
Public label: `0.2.5`
Release page commit: `8bc1ac558167121e7f28d9fb0bec05c039952206`
License: MIT

The public repository supplies a `0.2.5` label but no `v0.2.5` tag. This record
uses the release page's commit to identify the published version examined.

The project examined Stop That Shit for general ideas about direct delivery,
letting observed needs justify complexity, and scaling validation to the task.
Research Without Theater applies those ideas to research code and scientific
prose. The skill instructions and all other product materials were
independently written.

No text, code, Guard components, hooks, task contracts, runtime configuration,
or other files from Stop That Shit are copied into this product. No upstream
skill is loaded or called at run time.

The complete MIT text is in [LICENSE](LICENSE). No separate upstream `NOTICE`
file is required here; this record states the actual conceptual relationship.
